crossRefs.note: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.
Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.
When David and his men came to the city, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, their sons, and their…
While he was still speaking, there came also another, and said, “The Chaldeans made three bands, and swept down on the…
As gangs of robbers wait to ambush a man, so the company of priests murder on the path toward Shechem, committing…
I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
David said to Saul, “Why do you listen to men’s words, saying, ‘Behold, David seeks to harm you?’
David said to Abishai, “Don’t destroy him; for who can stretch out his hand against Yahweh’s anointed, and be…
Don’t say, “I will do to him as he has done to me; I will repay the man according to his work.”
Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.

translations.web: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.
translations.bsb: Though the ropes of the wicked bind me, I do not forget Your law.
translations.kjv: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.
translations.asv: The cords of the wicked have wrapped me round; But I have not forgotten thy law.
